text:
Aisha (CS): quick sync — Acme sent a note: want to move from a 12mo to a 9mo commitment, total commit $50k. They say procurement needs a PO before any signature. We have a draft amendment ready. Anyone urgent objections to approving this flow?
Tom (AE): no objections from AE. Pricing was agreed during renewal call — 9mo pro-rated at 75% annual. customer signed off on price.
Oliver (Finance): ok but we need vendor code + billing entity to accept a PO. If they can't provide VC today, what about a CC fallback for first invoice?
Aisha (CS): Customer prefers PO. They already shared tentative PO# PO-88921 (pending vendor code). I can push them to provide billing entity. Sending amendment to docusign now so signature can proceed once PO arrives.
Docusign Bot: Envelope sent -> envelope_id: env_0x9f2b | to: emma@acmehealth.com | status: sent | link: https://docusign.example/env/env_0x9f2b
Priya (Legal): quick read: amendment adds term swap + proration table — need to attach updated Exhibit A and add a one-line SOW reference for training credits. Also flag: data residency clause must remain in amendment. I'll add redline in next 30m.
Emma (CSE): Enablement note — kickoff planned for Wed 10am PT. Customer said they'd like training scheduled post-signature, but can do a 1-hr pre-kick if legal allows access. If contract ties credits to signature, we should wait.
Tom (AE): @Priya can we do 'SOW to follow' language so enablement isn't blocked? Customer is pushing to start enablement next week.
Priya (Legal): yes — we can include: "Training SOW to be executed within 30 days post amendment; credits reserved pending SOW execution." I'll draft.
Aisha (CS): @Oliver if vendor code isn't in place by EOD, are you okay with CC fallback for invoice 1 and require PO within 7 days to convert?
Oliver (Finance): CC fallback allowed with Finance approval — condition: we must receive PO copy within 7 days or next invoice will be paused. Also need a billing contact email on the PO.
Procurement Contact (Acme): Hi all — vendor code request submitted with our central ops (ref VC-req-332). Should hear back by EOD. PO will be issued immediately after code confirmed.
Aisha (CS): great — can you paste the vendor code here once you have it? I'll keep an eye on the envelope too.
Docusign Bot: Recipient viewed: emma@acmehealth.com | event: viewed | ts: 4749998798
Emma (CSE): if PO slips, we can run a "pre-onboarding" session for 5 seats next Tue as a non-billable intro (customer ok with limited access). That buys time.
Tom (AE): customer confirms pre-onboarding is fine, they'd prefer to get teams ramped.
Priya (Legal): uploaded redline: https://docs.internal/redlines/acme-9mo-amendment — main change: Exhibit A updated + SOW placeholder. Please review.
Aisha (CS): thanks @Priya. Action items: 1) @Procurement Contact (Acme) post vendor code here, 2) @Oliver confirm CC-fallback approval so billing knows, 3) @Tom confirm customer will sign once PO present, 4) @Emma hold pre-onboarding plan draft. I'll follow up in 4 hours. :thumbsup:
Oliver (Finance): CC-fallback approved for this instance — finance will accept up to 1st invoice on CC but require PO within 7 days. Sending note to billing team.
Tom (AE): customer rep says legal is fine with our redline and they will sign when PO arrives.
Docusign Bot: Envelope status update -> envelope_id: env_0x9f2b | status: completed | signer: emma@acmehealth.com | ts: 4749998901
Aisha (CS): signed — nice. @Procurement Contact (Acme) please still share vendor code so we can close the loop on PO conversion and invoice routing.
Procurement Contact (Acme): vendor code assigned: VC-ACM-44. PO-88921 will be finalized and sent to billing in the next 2 hours.
Aisha (CS): perfect — marking this as proceeding. I'll close the ticket once billing confirms PO matched to invoice. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
